effects: Only a registered Minter can call it, and only while optimistic minting is not paused.
It records an optimistic minting request (requestedAt = now) for the deposit keyed by keccak256(fundingTxHash | fundingOutputIndex), which starts the guardian cancel delay (3 hours by default).
No tokens, ETH or approvals move, for the signer or anyone else. The depositor and amount come from Bridge storage and appear only in the event.
formats.shown: "Request optimistic mint" with the raw funding tx hash and the output index.

findings.title: requestOptimisticMint: the depositor and the BTC amount come from Bridge storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: TBTCOptimisticMinting.sol requestOptimisticMint: `Deposit.DepositRequest memory deposit = bridge.deposits(depositKey);` then the event emits `deposit.depositor, deposit.amount * SATOSHI_MULTIPLIER`. The descriptor shows only fundingTxHash and fundingOutputIndex.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. The intent could say that it opens a mint request for a revealed BTC deposit.

findings.title: requestOptimisticMint: the funding tx hash is likely shown in Bitcoin internal byte order, reversed from explorers.
findings.evidence: descriptor field `fundingTxHash` format `raw`. tBTC stores Bitcoin tx hashes as hash256 output (little-endian), so the hex will not match a block explorer. No ERC-7730 format reverses bytes.
findings.fix: Put a hint in the label, e.g. 'Funding tx hash (internal byte order)'.

findings.title: requestOptimisticMint test case uses a placeholder hash, a wrong description and a tx that does not exist.
findings.evidence: cases/0.json: data uses fundingTxHash 0xbbbb…bb, description says 'Request optimistic mint finalization for a deposit', and minedError is 'tx not found'.
findings.fix: Use a real mined requestOptimisticMint transaction and describe it correctly.

effects: Only a registered Minter can call it, when not paused, after the optimistic minting delay has passed since the request, and only if the deposit is not yet swept or finalized.
It mints (deposit.amount - treasuryFee) * 1e10 TBTC, minus the optimistic minting fee (amount / feeDivisor, 0.2% by default), to the depositor recorded in the Bridge.
It mints the optimistic minting fee in TBTC to the Bridge treasury.
It increases the depositor's optimisticMintingDebt by the full amountToMint, which is repaid later when the deposit is swept.
It marks the request as finalized. No assets of the signer (the Minter) move, and no ETH is taken.
formats.shown: "Finalize optimistic mint" with the raw funding tx hash and the output index. It does not say who receives TBTC or how much.

findings.title: finalizeOptimisticMint: the TBTC recipient, mint amount and treasury fee come from storage and are not shown.
findings.evidence: TBTCOptimisticMinting.sol finalizeOptimisticMint: `uint256 amountToMint = (deposit.amount - deposit.treasuryFee) * SATOSHI_MULTIPLIER;` `_mint(deposit.depositor, amountToMint - optimisticMintFee);` `_mint(bridge.treasury(), optimisticMintFee);`. The descriptor has only the fundingTxHash and fundingOutputIndex fields.
findings.fix: None possible for the values. The intent could read 'Mint tBTC to depositor for revealed BTC deposit'.

findings.title: finalizeOptimisticMint: the intent does not say it mints tBTC to the depositor and books debt.
findings.evidence: descriptor intent "Finalize optimistic mint". The code mints TBTC to deposit.depositor and adds to optimisticMintingDebt[deposit.depositor].
findings.fix: Change the intent to something like 'Mint tBTC for BTC deposit (optimistic)'.

findings.title: finalizeOptimisticMint: the funding tx hash is likely in internal byte order and will not match explorers.
findings.evidence: descriptor field `fundingTxHash` format `raw`. tBTC uses hash256 (little-endian) Bitcoin tx hashes.
findings.fix: Put a hint in the label. No format reverses bytes.

findings.title: finalizeOptimisticMint test case uses a placeholder hash and a tx that does not exist.
findings.fix: Use a real mined finalizeOptimisticMint transaction.

couldNotCheck: Neither case has a mined transaction (both say 'tx not found'), so I checked nothing against receipts.
The Bridge source is not in the directory. I could not confirm the byte order of fundingTxHash or the fields of the Bridge deposit struct from the source.
